description: A company's annual figures exactly as filed with the SEC (XBRL companyfacts, 10-K/20-F/40-F): revenue, gross profit, operating income, net income, cash from operations, capex, D&A, stock comp, dividends, buybacks, assets, liabilities, equity, cash, goodwill, intangibles, debt and diluted shares, by fiscal year, with the XBRL tag behind each line and the filing each year came from. Optionally a trailing-twelve-month column built from 10-Q year-to-date facts. Keyed on the period a fact covers, not the filing it appeared in. Examples: {"ticker": "KO"}; {"ticker": "CTVA", "years": 5, "ttm": true}.

ticker.description: US-listed ticker that files with the SEC, e.g. KO or BRK.B

name: as_reported_financials
title: As-reported financials
